template.name: Genie
template.entry_long: crossabove(close, donchian_high_prev(high,{p0})) and roc(close,{p1}) > {p0} and adx(high,low,close,{p2}) > {p1}
template.notes: Parabolic SAR is unavailable, so the documented SAR flip up becomes a cross above the prior 3-bar high, the +DI-over--DI flip is proxied by a positive one-bar return, and ADX(14) > 20 stands in for the ADX-above-both-DI condition. SarStep, TakeProfit 500 and TrailingStop 200 are absolute price units with no percentage field.
